protocol: Summary, Evaluation, and Appraisal Protocol v4 compact
source_notes: Main text reports 5.0 life-years gained at age 70 versus no treatment; Supplementary Table 10 reports 5.4 (95% CI 2.9-7.8) for the SGLT2-containing quadruple regimen versus placebo.
The abstract and detailed methods describe slightly different search-date endpoints; the supplement documents the search and later analytic amendments.
The supplement protocol states LVEF <50% and an upper age statement of 70 years, whereas the main article describes adult HFrEF more broadly.
